title: MAC Tables & ARP
description: Understand how the switch builds its MAC table and how ARP resolves IP to MAC.
scenario: Understand how the switch builds its MAC table and how ARP resolves IP to MAC.

concepts.title: MAC Address Table
concepts.body: The switch learns source MACs and stores them with the port they arrived on. Dynamic entries age out after 300 seconds.
concepts.code:
Vlan  Mac Address       Type     Ports
1     00:1B:2F:3C:4D:5E  DYNAMIC  Fa0/1

concepts.title: ARP (Address Resolution Protocol)
concepts.body: ARP maps IP addresses to MAC addresses. When a device knows the IP but not the MAC, it broadcasts an ARP request.
concepts.code:
Who has 192.168.1.10? → broadcast
192.168.1.10 replies with its MAC

concepts.title: show ip interface
concepts.body: Shows the management IP of the switch (VLAN 1 interface). Used for remote management.
concepts.code:
SW1# show ip interface
Vlan1 is up, line protocol is up
Internet address is 192.168.1.2/24
